:::caution
This rule is part of the [nursery](/linter/#nursery) group. This means that it is experimental and the behavior can change at any time.
:::
## Summary
- Rule available since: `v2.6.5`
- Diagnostic Category: [`lint/nursery/noVueExcessiveProps`](/reference/diagnostics#diagnostic-category)
- This rule doesn't have a fix.
- The default severity of this rule is [**information**](/reference/diagnostics#information).
- This rule belongs to the following domains:
  - [`vue`](/linter/domains#vue)
- Sources: 
  - Same as [`vue/max-props`](https://eslint.vuejs.org/rules/max-props)

## How to configure
```json title="biome.json"
{
	"linter": {
		"rules": {
			"nursery": {
				"noVueExcessiveProps": "error"
			}
		}
	}
}

```
## Description
Limit the number of props a Vue component can declare.

A component with many props usually does too many things. Each prop is
another input that the component has to handle and that its users have to
understand. Splitting the component into smaller components keeps each of
them easier to read, use, and test.

This rule counts the props declared with the `props` option, and with
`defineProps()` in `<script setup>`. A prop name that is declared more
than once is counted once.

The rule only counts props whose names it can read. For example, it can't
count props declared with a spread (`...sharedProps`), or with a type
imported from another file.

## Examples

The examples below set `maxProps` to `2`.

### Invalid

```json title='biome.json'
{
	"linter": {
		"rules": {
			"nursery": {
				"noVueExcessiveProps": {
					"level": "on",
					"options": {
						"maxProps": 2
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

```

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
defineProps<{
  title: string;
  subtitle: string;
  icon: string;
}>();
</script>
```

## Options

### `maxProps`

Default: `10`

The maximum number of props a component can declare. It must be at least `1`.

```json title='biome.json'
{
	"linter": {
		"rules": {
			"nursery": {
				"noVueExcessiveProps": {
					"level": "on",
					"options": {
						"maxProps": 1
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

```

#### Invalid

```vue
<script setup>
defineProps({
  title: String,
  subtitle: String,
});
</script>
```
